assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmic triggers and assess stroke risk.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry was performed with CPT code 93229.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry was medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias and guide stroke-risk management.
The payer requires advance approval (prior authorization) for coverage of this diagnostic procedure to ensure medical necessity.
Advance approval was sought for this high-risk patient.
